place.name: Nerlandsøy Bridge
place.description: The Nerlandsøy Bridge (Norwegian: Nerlandsøybrua) is a bridge that crosses the Søre Vaulen strait between the islands of Bergsøya and Nerlandsøya in Herøy Municipality in Møre og Romsdal county, Norway. The 405-metre (1,329 ft) long Nerlandsøy Bridge opened on 25 September 1968.
